EntryTitle: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V061
Abstract: The Terra Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day (MOD11A2) Version 6.1 product provides an average 8-day per-pixel Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity (LST&E) with a 1 kilometer (km) spatial resolution in a 1,200 by 1,200 km grid.

MetadataAssociations.Description: MOD11A2 is derived from MOD11A1. Processing: 8-day temporal averaging of daily LST pixels. ATBD Section: 2.4. Source: 'Each pixel value in the MOD11A2 is a simple average of all the corresponding MOD11A1 LST pixels collected within that 8-day period.' Processing Formula: MOD11A2[pixel] = mean(MOD11A1[pixel, day1:day8]) with minimum 4 valid days requirement. Aggregates daily LST observations into composite product. ATBD URL: https://lpdaac.usgs.gov/documents/119/MOD11_ATBD.pdf

MOD03 provides geolocation information required for spatial mapping and georeferencing of MOD11A2 pixels. Essential supporting data for pixel coordinate reference. Geolocation data includes latitude/longitude per pixel at 1 km resolution used for spatial mapping and geographic registration. ATBD Reference: Appendix B (Ancillary Data Requirements)

MYD11A2 is the equivalent product from the Aqua platform. Both collections provide global LST observations with identical processing algorithms and output structure, enabling inter-platform comparison and complementary spatial/temporal coverage. MYD11A2 uses identical processing methodology as MOD11A2 but from Aqua MODIS instrument, providing enhanced temporal coverage through combined Terra-Aqua observations.
